# Frontend scoped instructions

Copy this file to `frontend/AGENTS.md` after Nuxt initialization if desired.

- Scope: `frontend/`.
- Stack: Nuxt + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn-vue.
- Use `<script setup lang="ts">`.
- Avoid `any`.
- Preserve SSR compatibility.
- Use semantic accessible HTML.
- Prefer IUGM design tokens.
- Run scripts that actually exist in `package.json`.
- Do not modify Laravel code from frontend-only tasks unless the API contract requires it.
